# VK
> VK is a social networking and internet services platform offering communication, communities, media, developer APIs, and business tools.

VK provides social networking, messaging, video, music, mini apps, advertising, and developer platform capabilities for users, creators, businesses, and partners.

## Main Platform
- [VK Home](https://vk.ru/): Main entry point for VK social network and platform services.
- [Feed](https://vk.ru/feed): Personalized news feed with posts, media, and recommendations.
- [Messenger](https://vk.ru/im): Private messages, chats, calls, and communication tools.
- [Communities](https://vk.ru/groups): Discovery and management of groups, public pages, and communities.
- [Video](https://vk.ru/video): Video browsing, publishing, streaming, and recommendations.
- [Clips](https://vk.ru/clips): Short vertical video creation and discovery experience.
- [Music](https://vk.ru/music): Music listening, playlists, recommendations, and artist content.
- [Games](https://vk.ru/games): Browser and social games available within the VK platform.

## Account and User Features
- [Login](https://vk.ru/login): Sign in to VK account and access platform services.
- [Join VK](https://vk.ru/join): Account registration and onboarding for new users.
- [Settings](https://vk.ru/settings): User account, privacy, security, and notification settings.
- [Friends](https://vk.ru/friends): Friend list management, requests, and social connections.
- [Photos](https://vk.ru/photos): Photo uploads, albums, tagging, and image sharing.
- [Bookmarks](https://vk.ru/bookmarks): Saved posts, links, products, and media for later access.

## Developers
- [VK Dev](https://dev.vk.ru/): Central developer portal for VK APIs, SDKs, and platform documentation.
- [API Reference](https://dev.vk.ru/reference): Reference documentation for VK platform APIs and methods.
- [VK ID](https://dev.vk.ru/products/vkid): Authentication and identity tools for VK-based sign-in flows.
- [Mini Apps](https://dev.vk.ru/mini-apps): Documentation for building apps that run inside VK.
- [Bridge](https://dev.vk.ru/bridge): JavaScript bridge for interacting with VK client capabilities.
- [SDKs](https://dev.vk.ru/sdk): Official SDK documentation and integration resources.
- [Community API](https://dev.vk.ru/api/community-events): Event and callback tools for community integrations.
- [Open API](https://dev.vk.ru/api): Overview of VK API capabilities, access, and usage patterns.

## Mini Apps and Platform Tools
- [VK Mini Apps](https://vk.ru/apps): Catalog of apps and services available inside VK.
- [Mini Apps Docs](https://dev.vk.ru/mini-apps): Guides and references for VK Mini Apps development.
- [VK Bridge Docs](https://dev.vk.ru/bridge): Client bridge methods for native platform interactions.
- [Design Guidelines](https://dev.vk.ru/design-system): Design resources for consistent VK app interfaces.
- [UI Components](https://dev.vk.ru/ui): Interface component guidance for VK platform products.

## Business and Advertising
- [VK Ads](https://ads.vk.com/): Advertising platform for campaign management, targeting, and analytics.
- [VK Business](https://business.vk.com/): Business tools for promotion, communities, and customer engagement.
- [Community Management](https://vk.ru/groups): Tools for operating brand and creator communities.
- [VK Pay](https://pay.vk.com/): Payment and transaction services for VK ecosystem scenarios.
- [VK ID for Business](https://id.vk.com/): Identity and login services for partner and business integrations.

## Help and Support
- [VK Help](https://help.vk.com/): Help center with articles on account, privacy, and platform usage.
- [Support](https://vk.ru/support): User support entry point for issues and account questions.
- [Safety Center](https://vk.ru/safety): Information about safety, protection, and responsible platform use.
- [Privacy](https://vk.ru/privacy): Privacy information and data handling policies.
- [Terms](https://vk.ru/terms): Terms of service and platform usage conditions.

## Products and Ecosystem
- [VK ID](https://id.vk.com/): Unified identity service for VK ecosystem authentication.
- [VK Video](https://vk.ru/video): Video platform for creators, viewers, and live broadcasts.
- [VK Music](https://vk.ru/music): Music service integrated into VK ecosystem experiences.
- [VK Calls](https://vk.ru/calls): Calling and communication features for personal and group conversations.
- [VK Teams](https://vk.team/): Collaboration and communication tools for organizations and teams.
- [Mail.ru](https://mail.ru/): Related communication and internet service within VK ecosystem.

## News and Updates
- [VK Blog](https://vk.company/ru/): Corporate news, announcements, and company updates.
- [VK Company](https://vk.company/): Corporate site with product, business, and investor information.
- [Developers News](https://dev.vk.ru/news): Updates for developers, APIs, and platform changes.
- [Press Center](https://vk.company/ru/press/): Press releases and official media announcements.

## Legal and Policy
- [Legal Information](https://vk.ru/legal): Legal documents and regulatory information for VK services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://vk.ru/privacy): Policy describing personal data processing and privacy practices.
- [Terms of Service](https://vk.ru/terms): Rules governing use of VK platform and services.
- [Copyright](https://vk.ru/copyright): Copyright-related information, notices, and complaint procedures.
- [Community Guidelines](https://vk.ru/rules): Rules and standards for content and user behavior.
